business_model: Usage-based metered sandboxes: prepaid balance, per vCPU hour, memory and disk

technical_complexity.rationale: Persistent isolated sandboxes using gVisor or VMs with per-minute billing are standard cloud engineering built on existing runtimes; a solo founder can ship it.

defensibility.rationale: Crowded lane with many YC and funded rivals; the main differentiator is price, which is easy to match.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Well-funded players already sold the same wedge at founding. No response found yet.

market_need_then: Rapid growth of coding agents and personal agents in 2026 created demand for hosted persistent environments. Launch HN thread reportedly drew 34 points and 21 comments (unverified).
